method: Retain source Tripo branch triangles and bark atlas; locally rebuild independent thin alpha-cutout foliage and attached twigs. Direct GLB processing, not an Editor-authored bundle.
findings: Thin ovate leaf silhouettes and central veins visible in closeup; earlier fused green clumps removed.
Source trunk architecture remains, with source bark atlas retained and one isolated brown branch connected by a repair twig.
Crown is airy and somewhat sparser than the approved 2D reference; user should confirm density.
New twig endpoints are attached to source vertices by construction; this does not establish a watertight union.
